title: Service Contracts: limits on changing the commitment by amendment, by tier
content:
## Scope
This reference gives the per-tier limits that apply when the minimum quantity commitment (MQC) of an Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts contract is changed by amendment: the largest increase, whether a reduction is possible at all, the largest reduction, and how late before expiry a commitment change may still be filed.

## Parameters by tier
| Tier | Largest increase (% of the current commitment) | Reduction allowed | Largest reduction (% of the current commitment) | Latest filing (calendar days before expiry) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Starter Service Contract | 50 | no | 0 | 60 |
| AHL Standard Service Contract | 50 | no | 0 | 60 |
| AHL Regional Account Contract | 50 | no | 0 | 60 |
| AHL Key Account Contract | 100 | yes | 10 | 90 |
| AHL Global Account Contract | 100 | yes | 15 | 90 |
| AHL Strategic Partner Contract | 200 | yes | 20 | 90 |

The latest-filing figure is the smallest number of calendar days that may separate the filing from the expiry date.

## Worked limits (hypothetical current commitments)
| Tier | Hypothetical current commitment | Largest increase | Largest reduction |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Regional Account Contract | 400 FEU | 200 FEU | none |
| AHL Key Account Contract | 1000 FEU | 1000 FEU | 100 FEU |
| AHL Global Account Contract | 3000 FEU | 3000 FEU | 450 FEU |
| AHL Strategic Partner Contract | 6000 FEU | 12000 FEU | 1200 FEU |

Each figure is the current commitment multiplied by the tier's percent and divided by one hundred.

## Tier notes
- A reduction of the commitment is open only in the Key Account, Global Account and Strategic Partner tiers.
- The first three tiers share the same four figures; so do the Key Account and Global Account tiers, apart from the largest reduction.
